newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson rises on rumours of upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson rises on rumours of upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson rallied on Wednesday afternoon amid rumours that Merrill Lynch has upgraded its trading recommendation on the company and its forecast for mobile telephone sales to the year 2000, brokers said.
Ericsson rose from 283 crowns to 291 crowns, a five crown gain on Tuesday's close.
"Merrill Lynch is rumoured to have upgraded Ericsson and this is what is moving the share. Lehman Brothers has been in and bought rather a lot," one broker said.
"I have heard that Merrill Lynch has upgraded its forecast for the sale of mobile telephones from 325 million to 500 million in the year 2000," said another broker.
At 1225 GMT a total of 1.9 million Ericsson shares had been traded with a total value of 536 million crowns.
